title: 04 · The chosen starting point
learn: £40,000.00 is in the home; £60,000.00 remains outside. The adjacent interest treatment belongs to the mortgage, not the purchase price.
persistent_objects: House, deposit boundary, mortgage and savings envelope.
interaction: Play begins the explicit £40,000.00 → £80,000.00 experiment; no personal selection is overwritten.

title: 05 · Borrowing and interest contract together
learn: The savings ribbon enters the house. The deposit band expands, borrowing contracts and the attached interest representation shortens under the same rate and term.
persistent_objects: The purchase body and attached external interest bracket are unchanged objects.
interaction: Pause here; hold the rate and term fixed before introducing the band.

title: 06 · The boundary is on the house
learn: A line appears at the existing deposit boundary. The fictional 80% borrowing share is named, then a separate tag turns over to show that a better rate may be available.
persistent_objects: Same purchase body, deposit boundary and debt identity; no separate percentage ruler.
interaction: Seek across the tag turnover or use Previous/Next; no quoted rate or eligibility claim.

title: 07 · Follow a monthly payment
learn: The envelope, interest and threshold explanation withdraw. A labelled monthly-payment slip emerges from the mortgage, attached briefly by a fine line.
persistent_objects: The mortgage remains visible; the newly introduced slip explicitly represents a flow, not debt principal.
interaction: The same slip continues into the next composition. Pause is immediate.

title: 07 → 08 · The slip takes its place
learn: The payment slip moves down and widens. The house recedes but remains recognisable; no second payment object replaces the first.
persistent_objects: Exact same payment rectangle and label nodes.
interaction: Drag the review timeline back and forth to examine the join.

title: 08 · The fixed budget makes the consequence visible
learn: Only after the payment settles does the fixed budget bracket appear. Compared with the smaller deposit, payment contracts and the available segment expands inside unchanged endpoints.
persistent_objects: Same payment; new budget bracket establishes its funding context.
interaction: Outline recalls the smaller-deposit payment. These are schematic monthly amounts, not calculated outputs.

title: 08 · A recurring opportunity
learn: One available-money tab leaves the budget for the saving/investment destination. This is a monthly opportunity, not cash present on purchase day.
persistent_objects: The available segment and its tab share the coral money identity.
interaction: Saving/investing is a stated choice. The study stops; it does not accumulate a future result.

title: 11a · Opening investment arrives at purchase
learn: Both strategies keep the same cash reserve. The smaller-deposit strategy starts with £40,000.00 invested; the larger starts with £0.00.
interaction: No return, winner or projected balance. The initial label stays visible as historical context.

title: 11b · Later money enters that same balance
learn: The balance follows the date marker. Monthly parcels descend into it and become part of its fill; they do not remain in disconnected pots.
persistent_objects: The same container receives opening and monthly contributions.
interaction: Schematic parcel sizes distinguish more/less monthly opportunity; not a monetary scale.

title: 11c · Different timing, one destination
learn: The two rows expose the competing starting and recurring contributions. No combined GBP total, return or winner is invented.
persistent_objects: One shared timeline; one balance per strategy; equal cash reserve.
interaction: Three illustrative monthly arrivals only. The full investment/time model is not built.

title: 13 · Bring your choice with you
learn: The familiar purchase and retained savings remain. Choose £40,000.00, £60,000.00 or £80,000.00 and a comparison horizon before starting the handover.
persistent_objects: A single deposit/date state, house, envelope and time rail.
interaction: Selectors are real fixed-fixture controls; changing either during motion pauses it immediately.

title: 13 → 14 · Make room, keep identity
learn: The house and envelope regroup as the existing controls travel continuously toward their working positions. Old mobile labels retire before settled labels return.
persistent_objects: Same DOM controls and state; no redirect, reset or replacement dashboard.
interaction: Pause or reverse the transition. The control path is driven by the same seekable clock.

title: 14 · The instrument is in your hands
learn: The chosen deposit and date remain editable. The opening allocation is explicitly labelled; an uncalculated analysis area joins the scene.
persistent_objects: The same financial objects now anchor a possible working composition.
interaction: This layout is a handover hypothesis, not a decision about the finished calculator, charts, 3D or access.
